explanation.functional_boundaries: Preserves the module interface and parameter declarations, positive-edge clock, synchronous active-high clear, and output latency. Reset establishes a one-hot state, and every transition preserves that invariant for all ten/twenty combinations, including simultaneous assertion with ten priority. Later clear assertions restore ready on the same edge as the original. No additional startup assumptions are introduced. Illegal internal state encodings need not match the original recovery behavior because they are unreachable after the required startup reset; equivalence must be checked against the frozen original under the supplied startup contract and default parameters.
